subject: Acme Health — request to sequester and clear tenant artifacts (prompts/outputs/logs)
messages:
From: Alex Doyle <alex.doyle@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Data Team <datateam@acme-health.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: purge of prompt/output artifacts and inferred logs for tenant 'acme-prod'

Hi Marissa,

Following up on our compliance meeting last week — Acme needs Redwood to fully sequester and purge prompt/assistant-output artifacts and the associated inference logs for the tenant 'acme-prod' covering the window 2024-11-01 to 2025-08-31. This is part of a customer-led data minimization request tied to our contract (Section 6).

Specifically we'd like: 
- Permanent deletion of prompt inputs and derived assistant outputs (all prompt logs, kv-cache derivatives) for the tenant.
- Removal/rotation of any short-lived tracing artifacts and operational logs that contain PII for the time window above.
- A confirmation package describing steps taken and artifacts produced as evidence (redacted logs + manifest).

Please advise the workflow, expected timeline, and the proofs we can expect. We may need a signed attestation for our audit.

Attaching the scope spreadsheet we use internally for intake.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Doyle
Head of Data Privacy, Acme Health

Attachments: acme_deletion_scope.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompt/output artifacts and inferred logs for tenant 'acme-prod'

Alex — thanks for the clear scope. We can support this. High-level plan and next steps: 

1) Intake & triage (today - 48 hours): confirm exact tenant id(s), retention holds, and any active legal/regs.
2) Create a tracked ops ticket and schedule a maintenance window for the sweep.
3) Technical execution (3–7 business days after triage): run KV/prefix purge, purge prompt logs, rotate/expire trace indices, and remove derived embeddings if in scope.
4) Verification & evidence (same day as execution): provide a deletion manifest (listing objects/keys removed), redacted log samples, and an internal attest file signed by Ops and Security.

We will also coordinate with Security for an attestation indicating keys/hashes of removed artifacts and steps taken to avoid collateral deletion.

I have attached a deletion_manifest_template.csv for your intake — please add any internal identifiers then we'll kick off.

I'll loop in Ops and Security (cc'd).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole

Team — technical intake notes and proposed runbook. I'll open INF-8243 and assign to Sweep Runbook.

Jira: INF-8243 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8243)
Planned window: 2025-09-05 02:00 - 06:00 UTC (low traffic)
Execution steps (high level):
- Snapshot metadata, export a list of keys/ids in scope (export to deletion_manifest.csv).
- Pause streaming writes for 'acme-prod' for the window, disable caching rewrite.
- Run purge_script_v2.sh (safe mode): removes prompt logs, kv-store derivatives, model-level transient traces. Script will produce a proof_manifest JSON with checksums of removed objects.
- Redact and export 3 sample logs for Acme validation (PII redacted).
- Rotate any per-tenant ephemeral keys and note KMS actions (no key zeroization unless requested by legal).

Estimated execution time: ~2 hours. Post-run verification and sign-off will take another 1–2 hours.

Attachments: purge_script_v2.sh (attachment stub)

Let me know if Acme requires key zeroization; otherwise we'll include KMS rotation notes in the manifest.

—Mina

Marissa,

Thank you. A few clarifying items from legal: 
1) We require a redacted sample (no PII) of before/after logs so our auditors can see the redaction approach.

3) If you rotate KMS keys, please confirm the KMS audit log entries. If you do not zeroize keys, state that explicitly and provide a mitigation note.

If you can provide an expected date for the signed attestation and the redacted sample, we can schedule our internal audit accordingly.
